$comment: Generated by tools/wire/gen-wire.mjs from docs/08-rewrite/contracts/api.openapi.yaml components.schemas. Do not edit.

error.description: Stable code, e.g. not_found, invalid_request, hash_mismatch, projection_pending, exceeds_memory_budget

collector_newer_than_server.description: A connected collector sent live frames with a table_version above the server's; those frames are not relayed (live-frame.md).

live.description: A connected collector reports this driver in a session (D5).

SessionOverview.description: Library row figures (from discovery and the current analysis). Null = not measured.

pace_slope_supported.description: Whether the backend's screened fit had enough eligible laps by its own rule (`race_investigation.runs[].fit`, null with `fit_unavailable_reason` under three screened laps with known exposure): true when at least one run of the phase has a fit, false when none has. Read from the analysis, never recomputed. Null when there is no `pace_slope_s_per_lap` or the analysis reports no runs. Always sent.

green_pace_median_s.description: Median green-lap time of the phase, seconds: the median of the backend's `lap_time_s` over the green laps its own screen kept (`race_investigation.laps[].eligible`); no lap is screened again. Null without an analysis or when the screen kept no lap. Always sent.

event_key.description: Groups phases of one event: 'subsession:<id>' or 'offline:<recording sha>'.

series_name.description: WeekendInfo.SeriesName of the session's first recording that names one; null for rows rebuilt from the NAS.

is_fixed_setup.description: WeekendInfo.WeekendOptions.IsFixedSetup of the session's first recording that states it: true fixed setup, false open setup, null when the recording does not say (never read as open).

library.description: `lab` when any of the session's recordings is lab, else `main` (this server always sends it).

Library.description: Whose driving a recording is: `main` (Joshua's own) or `lab` (the iRacing-utility's bot, its setup harvest and other agent-driven rig runs). The driver stays who drove it.

setup_ids.description: Setups observed in this session's recordings.

event_sessions.description: Other phases of the same event (phase switch), in session order.

schema_version.description: analysis_view schema the view was projected from: 1 (crate-api.md section 5 lists the accepted inputs).

profile_version.description: analysis_profile_version; empty string when the backend left it null.

Lap.description: One recorded lap (backend `laps[]` projected; unknown backend fields preserved).

comparison_eligible.description: Projector-computed: exclusion_reasons is empty (C# AnalysisLap not Confounded).

exclusion_reasons.description:
Projector-computed codes, RuntimeMapper.LapComparisonExclusionReasons (RuntimeMapper.cs:2525-2547) over the
backend laps[] in ascending `lap` order (stable), previous flag = the preceding lap's flag_state trimmed and
lowercased. flag = this lap's flag_state trimmed, lowercased, missing as "". In order: "partial" when complete
is not true; "caution_or_mixed" when flag != "green"; "pit" when pit_time_s >= 1; "not_racing_state" when
racing_state_fraction < 0.98; "off_track" when clean_context.on_track_fraction < 0.98; "close_traffic" when
clean_context.traffic_proximity_fraction >= 0.10; "restart" when the previous flag is "caution" and flag is
"green"; then damage_repair_context.exclusion_reason_codes (a string, or an array's non-null items, blanks
dropped; any other non-null value is one code, its JSON text), or
"damage_repair_context" when there are none and automatic_coaching_reference_eligible is false. A missing
or non-finite number skips its test. Duplicates removed case-insensitively, first kept. The browser
humanizes codes for display.

run_number.description: The runs[] entry whose lap_numbers contains this lap.

run_age_laps.description: Accumulated green exposure in the run (race_investigation.laps[].green_exposure).

pit_stops.description: One entry per run that ends in a pit service, in run order (projector-written from `runs[].pit_service`). Empty when no service was detected.

PitStop.description:
One pit service. `lap` is the run's `end_lap`, the lap the car enters the pits. Window, tires and fuel are the
backend's `pit_service` values; nothing is measured here. Null means the backend did not report it.

service_s.description: end_time_s - start_time_s, 3 decimals; the detected service window (stall, service-active or fuel-rise samples bridged within 2.5 s), not pit-lane time. Null when either end is missing.

tires_changed.description: Tires the backend observed changed (pit_service.tires_changed_observed): LF, LR, RF, RR, ascending. An empty list means none observed changed; null means the backend did not report the list.

fuel_added_l.description: pit_service.fuel_added_l; 0 is a measured no-fuel stop.

fuel_added_gal.description: fuel_added_l / 3.785411784 rounded to 3 decimals (the analyzer's own conversion).

post_run_service.description: The run ended with a post-run service (run.ended_with_post_run_service), e.g. after the checkered flag.

runs.description: Observed trend segments and screened fit stay distinct (AGENTS.md).

BackendRun.description: One backend run, passed through. Read by Runs, Traces (tire wear row) and Progressive Tuning.

SteeringBasis.description: TD-037: road-wheel steering when the ratio is known; never guessed. A declaration that is not basis road_wheel with steering_ratio > 0 is read as steering-wheel angle (SteeringBasisMapper.cs).

id.description: Stable signal id used by layouts and the cursor (e.g. speed, throttle, steering).

source_key.description: Backend analysis_view.lap_traces point key copied into this channel (e.g. speed_mph).

unit.description: The backend key's unit, as served (steering ids carry rad; the browser converts for display, rad to degrees).

TraceLap.description: One lap_traces.traces[] entry without its points (the points are in the CCOL body).

comparison_eligible.description: Joined from Lap by lap number (the first Lap with that number, C# lapsByNumber): its comparison_eligible; false when no Lap has this number (RuntimeMapper.cs:542-582).

exclusion_reasons.description: The joined Lap's exclusion_reasons; ["eligibility_not_recorded"] when no Lap has this number.

sector_times_s.description:
Seconds spent in each sector, one entry per `TraceCatalog.sector_start_pcts` item in that order (present only
when the session defines at least two sectors). Projector-derived from the lap's `session-time` bins: the
session time at the sector's end fraction minus the time at its start fraction, each linearly interpolated
between the two distance bins that straddle it (the retired desktop app's rule, `TimeAtPercent`); the last
sector ends at fraction 1. 3 decimals, bin resolution (bins_per_lap), so the sectors of a complete lap sum to
within about a bin of `lap_time_s`, not exactly to it. Null for a sector whose boundary the lap's bins stop more than two bins short of (a
partial lap, a lap that starts mid-lap), whose session time is missing, or that would read negative.

bins_per_lap.description: 160 today (about 0.6 % of a lap). Bin i lies at lap fraction (i + 0.5) / bins_per_lap (the CCOL rule on the traces endpoint).

signals.description:
The 15 fixed signals in this order when their backend key occurs (id <- source key): speed <- speed_mph,
session-time <- session_time_s, throttle, brake, steering <- steering_rad, steering-peak <-
steering_abs_peak_rad, slip <- slip_angle_deg, yaw <- yaw_rate_deg_s, lateral-g <- lateral_g,
longitudinal-g <- longitudinal_g, gear, rpm, latitude, longitude, tire-stress <- tire_stress_proxy; then the
backend's additional signals in backend order, up to 128 in all.

omitted_signals.description: Backend additional-signal keys beyond the 128-signal cap; not in the CCOL body.

sector_start_pcts.description: lap_traces.sector_start_pcts, ascending lap fractions in [0, 1) (Traces sector bands).

missing.description: Sentinel for integer dtypes; floats use NaN.

PathSeries.description: Parallel arrays of one backend path's points (x, y, lap_pct).

GeometryTransform.description: Maps recorded GPS into the geometry's space: x = (longitude - source_bounds.minimum_x) / normalization_scale, y = (source_bounds.maximum_y - latitude) / normalization_scale (race_foundations.py:226-247; C# AnalysisGeometryTransform.TryNormalize).

TrackGeometry.description: Backend track_geometry copied in its own coordinate space (no reprojection). Served only when the backend geometry has a main path; otherwise 404 and the browser uses the lap-distance strip.

transform.description: track_geometry.transform, else geometry_provenance.normalization_transform; null for legacy geometry.

series.description: Series names in this driver's recordings, ascending; the options of the Sessions series filter.

linked_setup_id.description: Null = values unknown (encrypted .sto, never seen unmodified). Derived by the server when it answers, never stored: only from an observation with is_modified = false or an htm_export of the file (collector-protocol.md section 8).

names.description: Known .sto names linked to these values.

raced.description: Seen in a Race session recording.

raced_count.description: Race sessions with a recording of these values (distinct sessions, of the asked library as `raced`). Null when the count is unknown: a recording of the setup is in no session yet or in one whose type is unknown. Never 0 for an unknown count. Always sent.

analysis_id.description: The session's current analysis (recording observations), so Tune this setup needs no second request.

values.description: CarSetup leaf key (e.g. Chassis.LeftFront.Camber) to the published string.

versions.description: This setup and the other setups of its car that carry one of its names and have use in the asked library, oldest first (`first_seen_at`, then `setup_id`). Always sent; one entry when there is no other version.

previous_setup_id.description: The version before this one; null for the oldest.

changed_count.description: Settings changed from the previous version: the backend's `counts.changed` of `POST /setups/compare` with the previous version left and this one right (readouts and readings are not changes). Null for the oldest, for a pair that does not compare (a side without values, or one known only from an export), and until the backend has compared the pair under the running worker; the server never counts changes itself.

unit.description: The displayed unit `left` and `right` end in (`-3.2 deg` is `deg`), split as the backend reads a displayed value; the present side's when one is missing. Null for text, bare numbers, ratios and lists, and when the two sides show different units. `left` and `right` keep the full displayed text.

TuningSessionIdentity.description:
Exact analysis identity, field for field from C# TuningSessionIdentity as filled by
RuntimeMapper.MapTuningIdentity (RuntimeMapper.cs:1735-1783). Sources are analysis_view
keys. C# RaceId, EventKey and Selector are server-bound (TuningSessionBinding); C#
AnalysisPath is server-internal and replaced by analysis_id. Null = not recorded.

iracing_session_id.description: C# SessionId: identity.session_id (WeekendInfo.SessionID), else source.selection.sim_session_num; decimal text.

setup_type.description: Open when identity.is_fixed_setup is false, Fixed when true, else Humanize(identity.setup_type), else Unknown.

embedded_setup_available.description: identity.embedded_setup_available, or identity.setup_parameter_count > 0, or a non-empty identity.setup object.

source_sha256.description: Union of track_geometry.contributing_source_sha256 (else source_sha256), track_geometry.observed_source_sha256 (else source_sha256) and source.fingerprints[].sha256; 64-hex values only, lowercase, unique, ascending.

TuningSessionBinding.description: Library binding filled by the server at request time (C# RaceId, EventKey, Selector).

TuningTurn.description: C# TuningTurn. Detected sections are never official turns (AGENTS.md).

corner_id.description: tuning_map turn corner_id (else id, else turn-<n>); detected segments use detected-<segment>.

apex_pct.description: Supplied apex_pct, else the forward-arc midpoint of start and end (RuntimeMapper.MidpointPercent).

confidence.description: Supplied confidence, else Unknown; Detected for detected segments.

user_verified.description: Always false in the projection; set by the browser from TurnAnnotations.

TuningMapView.description:
C# TuningMapView from RuntimeMapper.MapTuningMap (RuntimeMapper.cs:1785-1846): the
backend tuning_map when it has at least two finite points, else track_geometry.main_path
(lap_pct, else index / (n - 1)), else track_profile.shape. Turns from tuning_map turns or
corners, else track_profile.detected_corner_segments.

map_identity.description: tuning_map.map_identity, else map_id, else the track configuration key, else analysis:<analysis_id>.

source_label.description: tuning_map.source_label, else Verified track map (supplied map) or Recorded racing geometry.

confidence.description: tuning_map.confidence, else Recorded (path has 2+ points) or Unavailable.

TuningContextProjection.description:
Written by the projector as tuning.json (crate-api.md section 5). Eligibility ports
ProgressiveTuningCoordinator.Candidate for an analysed recording (finalized and exact by
construction).

eligible.description: Can receive a garage recommendation: setup_type Open, embedded setup, setup fingerprint, and analysis_id plus a track configuration key or layout.

can_use_as_evidence.description: Always true for an analysed recording; a fixed-setup race supplies driving evidence for an open target.

reasons.description: C# MissingRequired texts, then Blockers texts, in that order.

representative_runs.description: analysis_view.runs[] entries a driver may pick (TuningPage.EligibleRuns): damage_repair_context eligible (no automatic_coaching_reference_eligible false, no exclusion or reason codes) and at least 6 non-negative coaching_reference_lap_numbers; ascending run_number. The driver picks at most 3.

TuningOpenTarget.description:
Another analysis of the same driver that can receive the recommendation. Included when its
TuningContextProjection.eligible is true (ProgressiveTuningCoordinator.OpenTarget) and
CompatibleOpenTarget(evidence = this context's identity, target = its identity) holds
(ProgressiveTuningCoordinator.cs:68-82), in this order: target setup_type is "Open"
(case-insensitive); target embedded_setup_available; target setup_fingerprint non-blank; both
track_configuration_key non-blank and equal (ordinal, case-sensitive); then the car: when both
car_id are present they must be equal; otherwise both car_path must be non-blank and equal
case-insensitively; otherwise no match. A missing or blank key never matches; layout is not
a fallback.

TuningContext.description:
tuning.json plus the server-bound fields. draft_identity_key = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the
UTF-8 text of these values joined by "|", each trimmed and lowercased, null as "",
integers in decimal (ProgressiveTuningCoordinator.TuningIdentityKey order): analysis_id,
session_unique_id, subsession_id, session_type, track_configuration_key, car_id, car_path,
setup_fingerprint, source_sha256 joined by ",", binding.session_id, binding.event_key,
binding.group_key.

open_targets.description: Newest first; empty when identity.setup_type is Open (TuningPage.NeedsOpenTarget).

TuningDraftBody.description: C# ProgressiveTuningDraft as the browser keeps it. Unknown fields round-trip. D12 maps legacy drafts to these fields.

items.description: TuningFeedbackItem fields; a draft may hold incomplete items.

body.description: Turn-name corrections for one track configuration and map identity. Unknown fields round-trip.

items.description: TuningMapCorner fields (corner_id, label, start_pct, apex_pct, end_pct).

TuningFeedbackItem.description: C# ProgressiveTuningFeedback; closed because the worker's input schema is closed (mcp_server.py:714-737). Omit a pct rather than send null.

TuningMapCorner.description: C# TuningMapCornerIdentity: a turn as the driver verified it (start, apex, end form a forward arc, tuning_engine._normalized_corner).

TuningMapSubmission.description:
C# TuningMapSubmissionIdentity without its two hashes. The server adds geometry_hash (the
analysis's TuningMapView.geometry_hash; 422 when it is not 64 hex) and annotation_hash
(tuning_engine.map_annotation_hash: corners normalized and sorted by start, apex, end,
corner_id, pcts rounded to 6 places, source_type canonicalized, hashed as Python
json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False), floats in Python
repr) before calling the worker, so the browser never formats hash input. Closed because
the worker's input schema is closed (mcp_server.py:739-754).

source_type.description: Canonical (worker enum) or a C#/worker alias: official-iracing, iracing-game, official-nascar, official-track, user-confirmed.

TuningRecommendRequest.description: Server forwards to recommend_structured_open_setup_tuning with analysis paths resolved from the ids; ai_response is never sent in v1.

open_target_analysis_id.description: Required when the driving analysis's setup_type is not Open.

body.description: Up to 10 rows, up to 2 signals per row (AnalysisTraceLayout).

unit.description: A live-channels.json tiles[].units id (C, F, m/s2, lap, mph, ...), never a display label (°C). Null or an id the tile does not list selects the tile's default unit. D12 maps legacy labels (°C, °F, m/s², laps) to ids.

SessionFilters.description: Selections of the Sessions page filters; the values are the query values of `GET /drivers/{customer_id}/sessions`. An absent or empty list is no filter.

SetupFilters.description: Selections of the Setups page filters; the values are the query values of `GET /drivers/{customer_id}/setups`. An absent value is no filter.

car_paths.description: Selected cars (`car_path` values) when the page filters by several; absent, null or empty is no car filter. `car_path` stays for one car.

raced.description: true raced setups only, false never-raced only, null both.

text_size.description: Interface text step; null or absent is default.

session_filters.description: The Sessions page's selected filters, restored on the next visit. Replaced whole by a write.

setup_filters.description: The Setups page's selected filters, restored on the next visit. Replaced whole by a write.

error_code.description: worker_oom, worker_crash, timeout, tool_error, exceeds_memory_budget, nas_unreachable, ...

result.description: Tool result for Python-backed jobs (validated against its MCP contract where one exists).

relative_path.description: For setup files: path under Documents\iRacing\setups, forward slashes.

customer_id.description: Driver the collector last saw in session info when it listed the file; recorded on the occurrence. Recordings are attributed from the IBT at ingest instead.
Limits `setup_files` matching to one driver; recordings are matched by hash alone.

setup_files.description: File names as the library lists them, for example `e2e baseline.sto`.

found.description: Any file entry or garage visit carries the name.

applied.description: The changes listed here were made (false for a dry run, a blocked or an absent target).

blobs_kept.description: Blobs still referenced elsewhere or not yet on the NAS.

sessions_requeued.description: Sessions that keep other recordings; their analysis is queued again.

log.description: Path of the removal log written by a real call; null for a dry run.

from.description: Start, ISO 8601 with `Z` or an offset (`2026-10-04T08:00:00-05:00`); kept to the second.

until.description: End, not before `from`, at most 72 hours after it. The utility gives the planned end and posts the window again with the time it stopped.

car.description: `CarPath` (`stockcars2 supra2019`) or the car's screen name.

customer_id.description: One driver's recordings; all drivers when absent.

window_id.description: The window that files it lab; null when it goes to main.

lab_recordings.description: Lab recordings after the call (after a real one).

overlaps_kept_main.description: Recordings whose start falls in a window without its car, track or session kind; they stay main.

log.description: Path of the library log written by a real call; null for a dry run.

ImportBundle.description: Built by tools/migrate from a copy of the legacy data root (D12). Converted once.

notes.description: Legacy notes. subject_id is ignored; the server resolves subject_ref after re-ingest and discovery. Unresolved notes become legacy_items (kind note) and are listed in the migration report.

subject_ref.description: Stable identity of the subject, independent of new ids.

tuning_drafts.description:
Legacy Progressive Tuning drafts (the desktop app's portable-settings/tuning-drafts). A
legacy key cannot be reused: draft_identity_key (TuningContext) hashes the analysis_id and
the binding, which re-ingest and re-analysis change. The server resolves legacy_analysis_id
through legacy_analyses (the same map it gives import_legacy_tuning_experiments) to the
session's current analysis, computes that analysis's draft_identity_key exactly as
GET .../tuning does, and stores the body under it; body.open_target_analysis_id is rewritten
through the same map (null when unresolved). A draft whose legacy_analysis_id is null or
absent, does not resolve, or whose analysis has no projected tuning context, and a draft
whose new key an earlier draft of the bundle already took (bundle order), is stored as a
legacy_items row (kind tuning_draft, body = the bundle item). The import summary counts
tuning_drafts (stored under a new key) and tuning_drafts_unresolved (parked).

identity_key.description: The legacy draft's key (its file name), kept for the migration report; never used as the new key.

legacy_analysis_id.description: The legacy draft's representativeSession.analysisId; must also be listed in legacy_analyses with its stable identity.

legacy_analyses.description: Stable identity of every legacy analysis that legacy notes, tuning drafts or tuning experiments reference. The server resolves each to the matching session's current analysis (null when unresolved) and passes the map to import_legacy_tuning_experiments.

legacy_archive.description: The legacy worker archive's history.sqlite3 and tuning/ files, copied byte for byte. The server writes them under the import job root's legacy/ and runs import_legacy_tuning_experiments (worker-interface.md section 4) on them; nothing else reads them. The worker's own tuning/drafts/*.json travel here and are not converted: they are write-only records of past recommend calls (the worker never reads one back) and the next recommend call writes its own. They stay preserved verbatim because the server keeps every accepted bundle at import/<bundle_sha256>.json under COACH_DATA_DIR and never deletes it.

relative_path.description: history.sqlite3 or tuning/..., forward slashes, no .. segments.

legacy_items.description: Parked features' data preserved verbatim (saved Tests, plans, trials, activity).

SetupValues.description: CarSetup leaf key to the published string, all keys including derived ones.

update_count.description: UpdateCount of the last snapshot whose values this commit carries.

setup_name.description: DriverSetupName after exit. Set when the name changed within 5 s of exit, or when the exit state has DriverSetupIsModified 0 (the values are that file's); null only for a values-only commit of a modified setup.

GarageAck.description: Sent after the observation's SQLite transaction commits (or for a duplicate); the collector then drops the journal entry.
